name: floorplan
description: An interactive map of your codebase for Kimi Code, with architecture diagrams, health checks, screens, guided flows and read-only questions answered from real code.

author.name: Hayden Smith; Kimi fork maintained by urfv

interface.shortDescription: See how your app actually fits together
interface.longDescription: Kimi reads your codebase and draws an interactive map of its parts, files, endpoints and connections. Ask questions through a local read-only Kimi agent.
